title: Zeus to The Rock in five real photos?
description:
A giant Roman statue of Zeus, a G8 handshake and a Pentagon briefing connect the king of the Greek gods to Dwayne Johnson.

Zeus → Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama → Ash Carter → Kevin Hart → The Rock

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1 by Kremlin.ru, CC BY 4.0: http://kremlin.ru/events/president/news/75938
Photo 2 by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_and_Vladimir_Putin_shake_hands_at_G8_summit,_2013.jpg
Photo 3 by The White House from Washington, DC, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_and_Ashton_Carter_on_6_July_2015.jpg
Photo 4 by Ash Carter, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:161013-D-SV709-078_(30012677960).jpg
Photo 5 by Michaelbruhn, CC BY-SA 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Albert_mit_the_Rock_and_Kevin_Hart.jpg
